_note: Food, water, agriculture and the AI-economy claim, August 2026 videos. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: An AI boom makes the economy look great while the real economy is in trouble: an artificial economy built on AI, tech and crypto, running alongside a dust bowl and famine of biblical proportions.
mentions.quote: they will make it look an artificial economy with AI and tech and crypto
consequences: headline growth diverges from real conditions
mentions.falsify_match: AI-led market and GDP strength alongside deteriorating real-economy indicators.
mentions.falsify_miss: Broad-based growth, or an AI-led downturn instead.

mentions.claim_text: The next cycle carries two major events, plague and famine, with drought, water becoming very expensive, a dust bowl, and the acceleration of war in Europe.
mentions.quote: it's plague and famine and what the Lord was showing us about drought
mentions.falsify_match: A pandemic and a food crisis arriving together with European escalation.

mentions.claim_text: People relocate to Branson, Missouri because of drought and water problems, growing their own crops in gardens, with revival there.
mentions.quote: they were trying to move to Branson... because of water and things like that
mentions.falsify_match: Measurable water-driven migration into the Ozarks region.

mentions.claim_text: He is shown fuel, diesel and fertilizer for the fields alongside drought, and points to a JP Morgan warning that fertilizer shortages and a super El Nino threaten the global food supply with higher inflation by 2027.
mentions.quote: Fertilizer for the fields. Something very strong concerning this and drought
mentions.falsify_match: Fertilizer shortages feeding food inflation through 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: Fertilizer supply and food prices stay stable to 2027.

mentions.claim_text: More sobering days are coming to the nations, with drought and famine.
mentions.quote: I see drought. I see famine
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread drought and food shortage across multiple nations.

mentions.claim_text: Airport-style screening and pat downs spread to everything, the way security was implemented after 9/11, against constitutional objections.
mentions.falsify_match: Screening requirements extended beyond aviation into everyday venues.
